admission.justification: The setting is written in the daemon-settings module and documented in the settings reference, so one statement keeps idle seats from being closed after 60 minutes.

applicability: The daemon settings the product writes for the host it provisions.
conditions: The host is Paseo 0.14 or later, which closes idle runtimes by default.
exclusions: Settings the developer changes by hand after provisioning.
statement: The product writes agents.idleRuntimeCleanup false with its other daemon settings, so Paseo 0.14+ does not close an idle seat after 60 minutes.
